findings.detail: 'Is a new business required to register with the BIR, and what form is used?' — states BIR Form 1902 (registration for individuals earning purely COMPENSATION income = employees), not a business-registration form (a new business uses 1901 self-employed or 1903 juridical). Cited authorities are WITHHOLDING regulations (RR 2-1998/11-2018) + foundational NIRC Sec 2/3 — NONE is the registration authority (NIRC Sec 236). Wrong form + registration proposition verified on topic-mismatched/foundational authority (source-card laundering).
findings.defectClass: registration/procedural source-sufficiency (NOT covered by the current penalty/EWT gate)

findings.detail: 'Is the sale of gold by a small-scale miner to the BSP subject to VAT?' — 'not subject to VAT' conflates VAT-exemption with zero-rating, justified by hedged speculative reasoning ('may be exempt', 'may be exempt under specific provisions or interpretations of tax law') citing only general VAT-imposition sections (105-108, RR 16-2005). No controlling authority for the specific transaction treatment. Nondeterministic (verified only in r1).
findings.defectClass: exemption-vs-zero-rating / special-transaction source-sufficiency (NOT covered by the current penalty/EWT gate)
